mentions.name: PaperCove
mentions.description: A minimalist web reader for following RSS feeds, newsletters, and read-later articles in one place, helping keep reading material from piling up. Built with Laravel and Livewire, with Python for content extraction and Go for the email infrastructure; currently preparing a beta release to gather feedback.
mentions.problem: Keeping RSS feeds, newsletters, and read-later articles from piling up.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working since the start of the year on a minimalist web reader (https://papercove.app) that I use every day to follow RSS feeds, newsletters and read-later, and that helps keep things from piling up.
